changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla video_candidates: videos candidatos por tema (YouTube o cargados por el instructor) con similitud y estado de curaduría. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría video_candidates_audit y el trigger video_candidates_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Candidate videos of a topic collected from YouTube or loaded by the instructor

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: topic_id
column.remarks: Topic the video is a candidate for

column.name: youtube_video_id
column.remarks: YouTube video id

column.name: title
column.remarks: Video title

column.name: channel
column.remarks: Channel name

column.name: duration_seconds
column.remarks: Duration in seconds

column.name: language
column.remarks: Language code

column.name: has_captions
column.remarks: Whether the video has captions

column.name: characterization
column.remarks: Description of the video content used for similarity

column.name: characterization_source
column.remarks: Where the characterization comes from (captions, metadata, instructor)

column.name: similarity
column.remarks: Cosine similarity between the topic and the video

column.name: rank
column.remarks: Rank among the candidates of the topic

column.name: status
column.remarks: Status: candidate, in_use, backup or rejected

column.name: origin
column.remarks: Origin: youtube_api or instructor

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE video_candidates ADD CONSTRAINT video_candidates_status_ck CHECK (status IN ('candidate', 'in_use', 'backup', 'rejected'))
ALTER TABLE video_candidates ADD CONSTRAINT video_candidates_origin_ck CHECK (origin IN ('youtube_api', 'instructor'))
CREATE TRIGGER video_candidates_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON video_candidates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in video_candidates

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE video_candidates_audit ADD CONSTRAINT video_candidates_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER video_candidates_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON video_candidates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS video_candidates_audit_trg ON video_candidates
